mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Delete an ABAP object: a class, program, CDS view, table or another type.

description: Deletes the object named by object_type and its name parameter (class_name, program_name, ddl_name, table_name, …): sends the deletion request for its type, and answers SAP's result. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, transport_request) [onprem only], INTERFACE(interface_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request). CDS_UNIT_TEST deletes its test class. For LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS and LOCAL_MACROS (the class's local includes) and UNIT_TEST (its test classes include) the include is written empty under lock_handle, the class's lock handle. transport_request is sent with the request. Over Streamable HTTP an include write takes the lock's state_handle: send it as the state_handle argument of every call under the lock (or in the x-mcp-state-handle header); it is sent only under a lock the instance it reaches holds. When object_type is one of PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION; or lock_handle is given and object_type is one of LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST, recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

ddl_name.description: DDL source name (CDS view, AMDP table function, etc.).

lock_handle.description: The lock handle of the class (LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST): the include is written empty under it.

object_type.description: Object type. Supported: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST, PROGRAM, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE, BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION, LOCAL_TEST_CLASS, LOCAL_TYPES, LOCAL_DEFINITIONS, LOCAL_MACROS, UNIT_TEST.

transport_request.description: Transport request id, sent with the deletion (or the include write).

name: HandlerDelete
